title: The effects of underwater pressure on the body - Neosha S Kashef
speaker: TED-Ed
zh: 【TED-Ed】水下壓力對身體的影響 - Neosha S Kashef（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Sometimes when a fish is reeled up to the surface it will appear inflated,
cues.en: Sometimes when a fish is reeled up to the surface it will appear inflated,
cues.zh: 當魚被釣上水面時， 有時會呈現充氣狀態，

cues.text: with its eyes bulging out of their sockets and its stomach projecting out of its mouth,
cues.en: with its eyes bulging out of their sockets and its stomach projecting out of its mouth,
cues.zh: 眼睛凸出眼窩， 而且胃從口部翻出，

cues.text: as if its been blown up like a balloon.
cues.en: as if its been blown up like a balloon.
cues.zh: 而且胃從口部翻出， 就像吹氣球一樣。 這種肢體損傷是 因為壓力變化過劇造成，

cues.text: This type of bodily damage, caused by rapid changes in pressure,
cues.en: This type of bodily damage, caused by rapid changes in pressure,
cues.zh: 這種肢體損傷是 因為壓力變化過劇造成，

cues.text: is called barotrauma.
cues.en: is called barotrauma.
cues.zh: 這種肢體損傷是 因為壓力變化過劇造成， 叫做「氣壓性傷害」。

cues.text: Under the sea, pressure increases by 14.7 pounds per square inch
cues.en: Under the sea, pressure increases by 14.7 pounds per square inch
cues.zh: 叫做「氣壓性傷害」。 在海裡，每下降 33 英呎，

cues.text: for every 33 foot increase in depth.
cues.en: for every 33 foot increase in depth.
cues.zh: 壓力就會增加 14.7 磅力/平方英寸。 拿銼頭平鮋來說，

cues.text: So, take the yelloweye rockfish, which can live as deep as 1800 feet,
cues.en: So, take the yelloweye rockfish, which can live as deep as 1800 feet,
cues.zh: 拿銼頭平鮋來說， 牠們可在深達 1800 英呎的地方生活， 那裡的壓力超過 800 磅力/平方英寸。

cues.text: where there's over 800 pounds of pressure on every square inch.
cues.en: where there's over 800 pounds of pressure on every square inch.
cues.zh: 那裡的壓力超過 800 磅力/平方英寸。 相當於一隻北極熊站在 一個兩角五分硬幣上。

cues.text: That's equivalent to the weight of a polar bear balancing on a quarter.
cues.en: That's equivalent to the weight of a polar bear balancing on a quarter.
cues.zh: 那裡的壓力超過 800 磅力/平方英寸。 相當於一隻北極熊站在 一個兩角五分硬幣上。

cues.text: Now, Boyle's gas law states that the volume of a gas is inversely related to pressure.
cues.en: Now, Boyle's gas law states that the volume of a gas is inversely related to pressure.
cues.zh: 相當於一隻北極熊站在 一個兩角五分硬幣上。 再看看波以耳定律： 氣體的體積和壓力成反比關係。

cues.text: So, any air-filled spaces, like a rockfish's swim bladder,
cues.en: So, any air-filled spaces, like a rockfish's swim bladder,
cues.zh: 因此任何充氣的空間， 譬如像平鮋的魚鰾， 或是人類的肺，

cues.text: or human lungs, will compress as they descend deeper
cues.en: or human lungs, will compress as they descend deeper
cues.zh: 或是人類的肺， 下降越來越深時會壓縮， 上升時會膨脹。

cues.text: and expand as they ascend.
cues.en: and expand as they ascend.
cues.zh: 上升時會膨脹。 一隻魚咬到漁夫的魚鉤， 然後迅速被拉到水面，

cues.text: After a fish bites a fisherman's hook and is quickly reeled up to the surface,
cues.en: After a fish bites a fisherman's hook and is quickly reeled up to the surface,
cues.zh: 一隻魚咬到漁夫的魚鉤， 然後迅速被拉到水面， 魚鰾裡的空氣就會開始膨脹。

cues.text: the air in its swim bladder begins to expand.
cues.en: the air in its swim bladder begins to expand.
cues.zh: 魚鰾裡的空氣就會開始膨脹。

cues.text: Its rapid expansion actually forces the fish's stomach out of its mouth,
cues.en: Its rapid expansion actually forces the fish's stomach out of its mouth,
cues.zh: 快速膨脹將魚的胃從口中擠出，

cues.text: while the increased internal pressure pushes its eyes out of their sockets,
cues.en: while the increased internal pressure pushes its eyes out of their sockets,
cues.zh: 快速膨脹將魚的胃從口中擠出， 而內部壓力增加 則把眼睛推出眼窩，

cues.text: a condition called exophthalmia.
cues.en: a condition called exophthalmia.
cues.zh: 而內部壓力增加 則把眼睛推出眼窩， 這種狀況稱為「眼球突出症」。

cues.text: Sometimes rockfish eyes will even have a crystallized appearance
cues.en: Sometimes rockfish eyes will even have a crystallized appearance
cues.zh: 這種狀況稱為「眼球突出症」。 有時平鮋的眼睛 甚至出現結晶化的樣子，

cues.text: from corneal emphysemas, little gas bubbles that build up inside the cornea.
cues.en: from corneal emphysemas, little gas bubbles that build up inside the cornea.
cues.zh: 有時平鮋的眼睛 甚至出現結晶化的樣子， 這是角膜氣腫的關係， 角膜裡面產生小氣泡。

cues.text: Thankfully, a scuba diver doesn't have a closed swim bladder to worry about.
cues.en: Thankfully, a scuba diver doesn't have a closed swim bladder to worry about.
cues.zh: 幸好，潛水員不用擔心 封閉的魚鰾， 潛水員一邊上升時可以 藉由呼吸調整肺裡面的壓力，

cues.text: A diver can regulate pressure in her lungs by breathing out as she ascends,
cues.en: A diver can regulate pressure in her lungs by breathing out as she ascends,
cues.zh: 幸好，潛水員不用擔心 封閉的魚鰾， 潛水員一邊上升時可以 藉由呼吸調整肺裡面的壓力，

cues.text: but must be wary of other laws of physics that are at play under the sea.
cues.en: but must be wary of other laws of physics that are at play under the sea.
cues.zh: 潛水員一邊上升時可以 藉由呼吸調整肺裡面的壓力， 但還是要注意其他 海裡的物理定律。

cues.text: Henry's law states that the amount of a gas that dissolves in a liquid
cues.en: Henry's law states that the amount of a gas that dissolves in a liquid
cues.zh: 但還是要注意其他 海裡的物理定律。 亨利定律說， 溶解在液體裡的氣體量 和其分壓成正比。

cues.text: is proportional to its partial pressure.
cues.en: is proportional to its partial pressure.
cues.zh: 和其分壓成正比。 潛水員吸入的空氣 包含 78% 的氮氣，

cues.text: The air a diver breathes is 78% nitrogen.
cues.en: The air a diver breathes is 78% nitrogen.
cues.zh: 潛水員吸入的空氣 包含 78% 的氮氣，

cues.text: At a higher pressure under the sea, the nitrogen from the air in a scuba tank
cues.en: At a higher pressure under the sea, the nitrogen from the air in a scuba tank
cues.zh: 在海裡的高壓中， 氧氣筒中的氮氣 在潛水員組織的分佈 比陸地上的濃度大。

cues.text: diffuses into a diver's tissues in greater concentrations than it would on land.
cues.en: diffuses into a diver's tissues in greater concentrations than it would on land.
cues.zh: 在潛水員組織的分佈 比陸地上的濃度大。 如果潛水員上升太快，

cues.text: If the diver ascends too quickly, this built up nitrogen can come out of solution
cues.en: If the diver ascends too quickly, this built up nitrogen can come out of solution
cues.zh: 如果潛水員上升太快， 氮氣會從溶液中跑出來， 然後在她的組織、血液 和關節中產生微小氣泡，

cues.text: and form microbubbles in her tissues, blood and joints,
cues.en: and form microbubbles in her tissues, blood and joints,
cues.zh: 氮氣會從溶液中跑出來， 然後在她的組織、血液 和關節中產生微小氣泡，

cues.text: causing decompression sickness, aka the bends.
cues.en: causing decompression sickness, aka the bends.
cues.zh: 導致減壓症，也就是潛水夫病。 就像你汽水裡的二氧化碳氣泡。

cues.text: This is similar to the fizz of carbon dioxide coming out of your soda.
cues.en: This is similar to the fizz of carbon dioxide coming out of your soda.
cues.zh: 導致減壓症，也就是潛水夫病。 就像你汽水裡的二氧化碳氣泡。

cues.text: Gas comes out of solution when the pressure's released.
cues.en: Gas comes out of solution when the pressure's released.
cues.zh: 就像你汽水裡的二氧化碳氣泡。 當壓力降低時， 氣體會從溶液中跑出來。

cues.text: But for a diver, the bubbles cause severe pain and sometimes even death.
cues.en: But for a diver, the bubbles cause severe pain and sometimes even death.
cues.zh: 當壓力降低時， 氣體會從溶液中跑出來。 但是對潛水員來說， 氣泡會導致劇烈疼痛， 有時甚至導致死亡。

cues.text: Divers avoid falling victim to the bends by rising slowly and taking breaks along the way, called decompression stops,
cues.en: Divers avoid falling victim to the bends by rising slowly and taking breaks along the way, called decompression stops,
cues.zh: 有時甚至導致死亡。 潛水員為了避免成為 潛水夫病的受害者， 會慢慢上升，中間停下來休息， 叫做潛水減壓站，

cues.text: so the gas has time to diffuse back out of their tissues and to be released through their breath.
cues.en: so the gas has time to diffuse back out of their tissues and to be released through their breath.
cues.zh: 會慢慢上升，中間停下來休息， 叫做潛水減壓站， 讓氣體有時間 從他們的組織散出， 再藉由呼吸釋出身體。 就像潛水員需要減壓，

cues.text: Just as a diver needs decompression, for a fish to recover, it needs recompression,
cues.en: Just as a diver needs decompression, for a fish to recover, it needs recompression,
cues.zh: 就像潛水員需要減壓， 一隻魚如果要復原， 則需要加壓， 把牠放回海裡就可以了。

cues.text: which can be accomplished by putting it back in the sea.
cues.en: which can be accomplished by putting it back in the sea.
cues.zh: 把牠放回海裡就可以了。 不過這不表示可以 把魚直接丟到船外。

cues.text: But that doesn't mean that fish should just be tossed overboard.
cues.en: But that doesn't mean that fish should just be tossed overboard.
cues.zh: 不過這不表示可以 把魚直接丟到船外。

cues.text: An inflated body will float and get scooped up by a hungry sea lion or pecked at by seagulls.
cues.en: An inflated body will float and get scooped up by a hungry sea lion or pecked at by seagulls.
cues.zh: 不過這不表示可以 把魚直接丟到船外。 充氣的身體會在水面漂浮， 然後被飢餓的海獅一下撈走， 或是被海鷗叼走。

cues.text: There's a common myth that piercing its stomach with a needle will let air escape,
cues.en: There's a common myth that piercing its stomach with a needle will let air escape,
cues.zh: 有個很普遍的傳說， 說只要用針刺一下魚胃放氣， 就可以讓魚自己游回去。

cues.text: allowing the fish to swim back down on its own.
cues.en: allowing the fish to swim back down on its own.
cues.zh: 說只要用針刺一下魚胃放氣， 就可以讓魚自己游回去。

cues.text: But that is one balloon that shouldn't be popped.
cues.en: But that is one balloon that shouldn't be popped.
cues.zh: 就可以讓魚自己游回去。 但這個「氣球」可不能戳。

cues.text: To return a fish properly to its habitat, fisherman can use a descending device instead
cues.en: To return a fish properly to its habitat, fisherman can use a descending device instead
cues.zh: 要讓魚好好地回到棲息地， 漁夫可以用一個下降裝置，

cues.text: to lower it on a fishing line and release it at the right depth.
cues.en: to lower it on a fishing line and release it at the right depth.
cues.zh: 漁夫可以用一個下降裝置， 用魚線慢慢下降， 再在適當的深度放開。

cues.text: As it heads home and recompression reduces gas volume, its eyes can return to their sockets and heal,
cues.en: As it heads home and recompression reduces gas volume, its eyes can return to their sockets and heal,
cues.zh: 用魚線慢慢下降， 再在適當的深度放開。 等魚回家之後， 加壓減少了氣體體積， 牠的眼睛就可以 回到眼窩內然後復原，

cues.text: and its stomach can move back into place.
cues.en: and its stomach can move back into place.
cues.zh: 牠的眼睛就可以 回到眼窩內然後復原， 牠的胃也可以回到原處。

cues.text: This fish will live to see another day, once more free to swim, eat, reproduce and replenish the population.
cues.en: This fish will live to see another day, once more free to swim, eat, reproduce and replenish the population.
cues.zh: 這隻魚就可以繼續過牠的生活， 重新游水、覓食、繁殖， 繁衍更多後代。
